text:
Claire: quick heads-up — ran into an a11y gap in the Jobs table when doing shift+select across virtualized rows. NVDA/VoiceOver don't announce totals or range selects reliably. Ravi: repro steps: open Jobs > table, scroll so some rows are offscreen, shift+click a row top and bottom that spans offscreen. visual selection looks fine but SR says nothing. :eyes: Jon: this is typical with virtualization. offscreen rows aren't in DOM so screen readers can't read them. two options: 1) aria-live summary updates, 2) single summary element in header that reflects selection state. Sana: i'd prefer both: live region for SR users + a persistent counter in the header for keyboard users. for mouse users a short toast with CTA works. keep visuals light. Ravi: question — polite or assertive live region? when shift-selecting rapidly we might spam SR. Jon: use polite and debounce (150-300ms). set aria-atomic=true so the full string is read. assertive will be too disruptive. also add role="status" for older SRs. Claire: component API proposal: Table props -> `selectionAnnouncement` (string | (count)=>string), `announceOnRangeSelect` (bool, default true), `liveDebounceMs` (number, default 200), and `showPersistentCounter` (bool). Ravi: implementation note: create a single offscreen live region at app-shell level and update text on changes. example: ```html
3 rows selected
``` // update innerText (debounced) when selection changes ``` Jon: add aria-rowcount and aria-rowindex to visible rows so SRs can infer context. when selection spans offscreen, the header counter should read like: "3 rows selected" and the toast copy: "3 rows selected — Apply bulk action" with a clear CTA. keep i18n keys short: `table.selection_count`. Sana: visual thought: maybe a faint dashed gradient at top/bottom when selection continues offscreen. but i worry about visual noise. prefer just counter + toast for large selections (>20 rows). Claire: agree. rule: show `selection-preview` toast only when count > 20 or when user triggers a bulk action intent. otherwise persistent counter + live region. Ravi: i'll prototype in components/table and add a story showing shift+select across virtualization. will include toggles for liveDebounceMs and selectionAnnouncement override. linking branch in PR. :thumbsup: design-bot: uploaded screenshot — https://redwood-internal.s3/aws/mockups/selection-announce.png Jon: small accessibility checklist for the PR: 1) live region exists and is debounced, 2) role=status fallback, 3) visible rows include `aria-rowindex`/`aria-rowcount`, 4) localized announcement through i18n key. Sana: i'll draft a few toast copy variants in Storybook knobs: short, helpful, and one with action included. Claire: action items: Ravi -> PR + story; Jon -> review aria attributes; Sana -> copy & visuals; Claire -> add changelog note. Ravi: PR started, ETA EOD. Jon: i'll review tomorrow AM. Claire: thanks all, closing loop. :white_check_mark:
